issue.title: STAGE 02.1 — Palette UX, right Inspector dock & tooltips (0.2.1-dev)
issue.body:
# GO_FLORA — STAGE 02.1: Palette, Inspector & Dock UX pass

**PROJECT:** GO_FLORA  
**PARENT STAGE:** 02 — Imported Assets & Alpha Vegetation, [Issue #5](https://github.com/alekseypilishkov-gif/go_flora/issues/5)  
**EXISTING PR:** [Draft PR #6](https://github.com/alekseypilishkov-gif/go_flora/pull/6) — **update this PR, do NOT make an unrelated new PR**  
**WORKING BRANCH:** `codex/stage-02-imported-alpha` (current head when assigned: `875e2ea6e587111a1476f17bbbeca1d18f5bdc99`; pull latest before coding)  
**ENGINE:** Godot `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`  
**TARGET PLUGIN VERSION:** `0.2.1-dev` (internal ZIP/dev build; no published release)  
**OUTPUT FOLDER:** `stages/02_imported_alpha_vegetation/updates/01_palette_dock_ux/`  
**IMPORTANT:** Do not merge PR #6, do not start Stage 03, do not modify `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA` without a separate explicit owner instruction.

## User-reported problems, actual UI

The owner is testing GO_FLORA `0.2.0-dev` in **`C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA`**, after installing the addon and importing textures. On the user's real Godot screenshots:

1. In Inspector of `GFVegetationSet` (`set-a`), `Entries: Array[GFPaletteEntry]` has four entries `0..3`, all visually named **`GFPaletteEntry`**, even though they mean `Green cone bush` (weight 3), `Orange block shrub` (1), `grass` (1), `flower` (1). It is impossible to identify a plant without expanding the resource. The user wants to disable cone/cube and switch between grass, flower and a mixed vegetation palette.
2. GO_FLORA dock shows on the **left alongside Scene/Import**, although owner explicitly wants it on the **right alongside Inspector**.
3. `Edit Set in Inspector` appears inert/unclear. The first screenshot shows `Set ID=set-a` in Inspector, so the resource is accessible; the real UX defect is unreliable/unclear focus and opaque resource entries. Verify true button behavior rather than asserting a proven functional failure.
4. User requests concise **tooltips and popup explanations** for what brush/source/set parameters and buttons do, ideally **in Russian** while keeping existing identifiers and API stable.

Current source facts verified: `addons/go_flora/editor/plugin.gd` uses `add_control_to_dock(DOCK_SLOT_LEFT_UR, _dock_scroll)`, `EditorResourcePicker` thumbnails, `get_editor_interface().edit_resource(active_set)`, and `GFPaletteEntry` only has `source` and `weight`. Weighted source choice in `GFPlacement.choose_source` sums and samples entries by weight. These are implementation facts, not evidence of user-facing GUI correctness.

## Scope A — right-side dock, no layout regression

- Change the **default installation slot** to the right Inspector tab group, ordinarily `DOCK_SLOT_RIGHT_UL` in Godot 4.7.2; verify the actual Inspector tab group in a fresh editor layout.
- Respect existing saved Godot editor layouts (especially owner's `TEST_FLORA`): do **not** modify `.godot/editor/`, `project.godot`, layout files, or force the user into a new arrangement on each start. If Godot restores a previous left-side placement, document the one-time tab drag to the right; the default for new projects must still be correct.
- Preserve Stage 01/02 validated bounded minimum `260 × 120 px` for dock and stable width under long status messages, many sources and during stroke; FileSystem, Output and Inspector remain usable.
- Ensure dock can be shown/focused easily when an editing command requires it.

## Scope B — meaningful asset palette and switching

Provide a **named, directly usable source palette in GO_FLORA dock**, not only unnamed Inspector array rows. Four starting entries must be recognizable at a glance:

`Green cone bush`, `Orange block shrub`, `grass`, `flower`, each with a preview/icon (where supported), **human name**, source kind/ID accessible via tooltip, current weight, and enabled state.

- Clearly distinguish **source** (plant), **VegetationSet** (weighted group), and tool mode `Single` (place exactly ONE record). Do not conflate a selected source with the Single placement tool.
- Provide explicit **Brush sources: Mix by weights / Selected source only** mode. Clicking/choosing a plant sets it as the selected source for new Paint/Single placements; switch back to Mix without destroying/restoring unrelated palette settings.
- Allow **enable/disable per entry** for new mixed placements using an intuitive checkbox; retain a positive weight when disabled and re-enabled. Do NOT remove the resource or existing logical placements when disabling. Consider an additive `enabled=true` on `GFPaletteEntry`, preserving legacy serialization and sampling when all enabled; or another equally nondestructive design justified and tested.
- Provide editable weight in the named row (SpinBox, >=0), with descriptive help: relative probability in MIX, not count of already painted objects. Disabled/zero-weight entries are excluded from new MIX placements.
- Disable/block painting with a clear status when no eligible active source remains. For `Selected source only` require the selected source to exist and be valid; handle deleted/renamed/reimported/unsupported sources gracefully. Erase and saved records must still work for unavailable/disabled sources.
- Persistent changes to entry enabled/weight and palette composition should use scene-appropriate **EditorUndoRedoManager** where practical, with updates to the visible dock, Inspector and render diagnostics. Transient brush source selection must NOT silently rewrite `VegetationSet.entries` or existing records.
- **Do not change** deterministic behavior for existing Stage 01/02 scenes in default MIX/all-enabled mode. Preserve stable record/source IDs, seeded sampling and current legacy `GFPaletteEntry.weight` semantics; add direct tests for both new selection modes.
- Do not duplicate resource-creation flow or add a destructive delete shortcut.

## Scope C — Inspector entries identifiable

Owner specifically reports that Inspector `Entries` labels are all `GFPaletteEntry`. In addition to named dock list:

- Implement the **supported Godot EditorInspectorPlugin / EditorProperty approach** for `GFVegetationSet.entries` if necessary to show a proper human-readable list (at minimum `display_name`, source ID/type and weight) in Inspector, rather than four indistinguishable labels. Preserve native editing of set IDs, enabled, density, draw distance and resource references.
- Do **not** monkey-patch Godot internals or mutate `Resource.resource_name` in a way that breaks source identity. Preserve serialized `Array[GFPaletteEntry]` and Undo/Redo; test plugin register/unregister and Inspector selection.
- If custom array editing proves incompatible with 4.7.2, document the exact limitation and ensure the **dock's named palette** is the documented primary interface with discoverable inspection of underlying entries. Do not falsely claim Inspector arrays were renamed.

Godot official API reference: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/plugins/editor/inspector_plugins.html and https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_editorinspectorplugin.html ; test on exact installed engine rather than assuming latest docs equal 4.7.2.

## Scope D — make Edit Set in Inspector obvious

- Clicking **Edit Set in Inspector** (may relabel `Open Set in Inspector`) must select the actual active `GFVegetationSet`, focus/show Inspector tab even if GO_FLORA shares its dock group, and display `set_id/display_name/entries`; use stable official editor APIs, no brittle hierarchy hacks without evidence.
- Give immediate understandable status if no layer/set; show concise status after success, without resizing the dock.
- If direct focus is not supported by official 4.7.2 API, document the limitation and provide an obvious alternative (named inline palette and a clear one-click Inspector path). Do not present an inert button.
- Verify when owner has `VegetationLayer` selected, other scene nodes selected, different active sets, and after disable/enable and scene switch.

## Scope E — tooltips / inline help

Every frequently used parameter should have a short **Russian tooltip** and/or readily visible `?` help control, using Godot native tooltip facilities; avoid giant always-visible help text that expands the dock.

Minimum coverage:
- Active Layer; VegetationSet; asset thumbnails/row selected-vs-enabled; Mix vs Selected source; per-source weight; `Edit Set in Inspector`/help.
- `Draw distance (m)` (0=unlimited, existing cells affected, not painting radius), `Enabled` and `Density Multiplier`.
- Paint/Erase/Single/Navigate; Radius, Density per m², Spacing, Seed, Yaw min/max, Scale min/max, Align Normal, Slope min/max, Height min/max and relative-to-layer, Collision Mask, Ray Range, Stroke Work Budget.
- `Create Alpha Plant`: Texture2D, single/crossed/radial, Width/Height, Splay, Alpha Threshold (scissor), Atlas X/Y/W/H, Gutter; `Add Mesh/GLB/Scene` and `Source diagnostics / revision`.
- Describe defaults and units, show meaningful example values only where helpful; explain that disabling source only affects NEW placements and distance hides entire MultiMesh cells.
- Make help accessible via hover and at least one click-open Help/legend action for touchpad/non-hover access. Ensure no disruptive popups on every stroke or keyboard navigation.
- Keep English button labels if that avoids broad localization scope, but Russian explanations should be understandable to owner.

## Evidence and acceptance

**NON-NEGOTIABLE Stage 02 functional regression**: 87 Stage 02 core assertions, 62 Stage 02 native Editor API, Stage 01 original regression, imported GLB, alpha-scissor GPU checks, scene fallback/multi-part batching, source reimport, save/reopen and per-set draw distance. Do not weaken existing cases.

Add isolated tests:
1. New default dock shares Inspector's right tab group in fresh layout; `260×120` min bound and stable width after dynamic count/status and palette edits. Saved custom layout is not overwritten.
2. Four names are distinguishable in dock and (if custom Inspector succeeds) Inspector; correct source-ID and weight binding; display refresh after rename/reimport/set switch; no stale callbacks or duplicate controls on plugin enable/disable.
3. First cone/cube disabled, grass and flower enabled => MIX records contain only grass+flower. Toggle enabled preserves weights, and undo restores exact state. Paint selected grass => only grass, then selected flower => only flower; revert MIX uses prior weights. Existing placement IDs/count/transforms unchanged by switching/enable/weight changes.
4. No enabled sources / invalid selected source reports readable diagnostic; Erase remains safe, no data lost.
5. `Open Set in Inspector` selects correct resource, Inspector focus or documented alternative, across scene/set changes. Visual GUI manual check remains required.
6. Tooltips are present and nonempty for listed controls, especially numeric fields that currently have none; user-facing Help action actually opens content without stretching panel.
7. ZIP-only packaging, CRC/SHA, clean import in disposable project, repeated update preserves user scenes/config; work on `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA` is **forbidden until the owner separately opts in**.
8. Actual mouse GUI owner checklist: right-side tab, four readable assets, select-only grass/flower, toggle cone/cube, MIX weighting, Undo/Redo, tooltip, Inspector focus, drag/brush, save/reopen. If not performed by Codex: **GUI NOT_RUN / READY_FOR_MANUAL_QA**.

**Outputs:** code under `addons/go_flora/`, tests under `tests/`, stage update report in Russian, logs/QA/CI in `stages/02_imported_alpha_vegetation/updates/01_palette_dock_ux/`. Update addon docs and parent Stage 02 report links without rewriting historical evidence. Update version to `0.2.1-dev` as needed, generate **plugin-only ZIP** with manifest/digests and safe owner-invoked installer; DO NOT install in owner TEST_FLORA automatically.

**Stop condition:** commit/push this **same** Stage 02 branch, update the **same Draft PR #6**, run all CI and report the updated HEAD, packaging, native tests and what remains GUI NOT_RUN. **No merge, no release, no Stage 03.**
